title: Universal Life Insurance Actuarial Worksheet: Protected Face on Overloan Protection
content:
Worksheet for the protected face that becomes the face amount of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy when overloan protection is carried out.

## Definition

The protected face is the account value shown at the latest monthly anniversary, as it stands on the policy record, less the overloan protection charge booked in the policy's activity history, times the corridor factor for the insured's attained age on the exercise date, rounded to the cent once at the end. No intermediate figure is rounded.

The overloan protection charge booked is the total of the overloan protection charge entries in the activity history. Attained age is the insured's age last birthday on the exercise date.

## Corridor factor

The corridor factor is the tier's corridor factor for the insured's attained age on the exercise date. For the ages at which the rider can be exercised it is:

| Insured's attained age | Corridor factor |
|---|---|
| 75 through 90 | 1.05 |
| 91 | 1.04 |
| 92 | 1.03 |
| 93 | 1.02 |
| 94 | 1.01 |
| 95 and over | 1.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Account value | Charge booked | Value less charge | Attained age | Factor | Protected face |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $200000.00 | $7000.00 | $193000.00 | 82 | 1.05 | $202650.00 |
| $200000.00 | $7000.00 | $193000.00 | 93 | 1.02 | $196860.00 |
| $154321.77 | $5401.26 | $148920.51 | 95 | 1.00 | $148920.51 |
| $120000.00 | $4185.33 | $115814.67 | 91 | 1.04 | $120447.2568, so $120447.26 |
